entry.description: Bahiti (Marksman) + Norah (Lancer) combo — both heroes fully deterministic, single run sufficient. Tests Marksman+Lancer pairing and Norah's splash interaction with Bahiti's buffs.

WOS-27: Norah S2 primary-target test. WIP attacks with 1,000 T6 infantry and no heroes; minxxx defends with 50/50/50 T6 and Norah 2/2/2. Four captured endpoints are 643, 643, 646, and 645 WIP infantry survivors. Battle Details recorded 20, 21, 16, and 16 S2 procs across the four runs (the two 643 runs had 20 and 21), with 3 displayed kills at the game's 35% reporting scale in every run.

Sergey+Norah+Zinman 3-hero combo — Inf+Lanc+Mark class heroes, all NC (no chance skills), single run definitive. Tests 3-class buff stacking with deterministic skills. WIP attacks (no hero, t6 800/800/800), minxxx defends with all three heroes.
